citations.claim: Initial total energy is 1014 J with stacked touching pairs.
Energy still within bound just before bounce, ~1015 J.
First violating step: energy jumps to ~1134 J exceeding allowed 1120.4 J.

explanation: Stacked e=1 bodies falling under g=30 with large dt hit the floor nearly simultaneously. Sequential impulse + positional correction for multiple restitution contacts (body-body plus floor) injects energy: light body rebounds upward at high speed while heavy bodies gain downward/upward velocity, raising total mechanical energy ~120 J in one step with zero controller work.
vision_note: Four circles fall together as a tight cluster and reach the floor together by step 22. There is no visible scattering, penetration, or escape, only smooth downward motion into simultaneous contact.
